defs.def: to come near to sb/sth in distance or time （在距离或时间上）靠近，接近

ex.s: With life in the unforgiving Northern Canada being so demanding, the Inuit’s practical approach to morality made good sense.
ex.t: 鉴于加拿大北部严酷的生活环境如此苛刻，因纽特人务实的道德观很有道理。

ex.s: So I approached our uninvited guest slowly and，through the fence，sprayed him in the face.
ex.t: 于是我慢慢接近这位不速之客，隔着栅栏朝它脸上喷了胡椒喷雾。

ex.s: You should remain modest when approaching perfection.
ex.t: 在趋近完美时，你应当保持谦虚。

ex.s: China’s approach to protecting its environment while   70   (feed) its citizens “offers useful lessons for agriculture and food policymakers worldwide,” says the bank’s Juergen Voegele.
ex.t: 中国在保护环境的同时70（养活）公民的做法"为全球农业和食品政策制定者提供了有益的启示，"银行的Juergen Voegele说。

ex.s: But as the 200th anniversary of his birth approaches, it is possible — and important for our own culture—to understand how he made himself a lasting one.
ex.t: 但随着他诞辰200周年临近，去理解他如何让自己成为不朽作家，不仅是可能的，也对我们自身的文化十分重要。

ex.s: As I approached mile 23, I could see my wife waving a sign.
ex.t: 接近23英里时，我看见妻子挥舞着牌子。

ex.s: As you approach people, be polite.
ex.t: 当你接近别人时要有礼貌。

ex.s: As the first day of our trip approached, David, my eight-year-old brother, and I unwillingly said good-bye to all of our friends.
ex.t: 她认为世界上每个人都和她一样善良。

ex.s: Son: (nervously approaching the table) Erm...Dad, can we talk?
ex.t: 儿子： （紧张地走近桌子）呃……爸爸，我们能谈谈吗？

ex.s: What is approached in sentence (b)?
ex.t: 句子(b)中讨论的是什么？

ex.s: The main finding was that the dogs approached the experimenter significantly sooner in the unable scenario than in the unwilling scenario.
ex.t: 主要发现是，在"做不到"情境中，狗接近实验者的速度明显比在"不愿意"情境中快得多。

defs.def: to speak to sb about sth, especially to ask them for sth or to offer to do sth 接洽；建议；要求

ex.s: Although she had heard warnings about an approaching snowstorm, she didn’t give it much thought.
ex.t: 尽管她听说过即将到来的暴风雪的警告，但她没太当回事。

ex.s: She also approached dentists to learn more about teeth cleaning.
ex.t: 她还拜访牙医，以了解更多关于洁牙的知识。

defs.def: to come close to sth in amount, level or quality （在数额、水平或质量上）接近
to start dealing with a problem, task, etc. in a particular way 着手处理；对付

ex.s: Over the years, there have been a number of different techniques to help designers approach this important point.
ex.t: 多年来，出现了许多不同的技巧，帮助设计师处理这一要点。

ex.s: One night, in my early 40s, I dreamed that a big woman in red approached me, handed me a bag of paints, and told me to start painting.
ex.t: 在我40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，让我开始画画。

ex.s: Approached in this way, your friendship will soon be repaired.
ex.t: 以这种方式处理，你们的友谊很快就会修复。

defs.def: a way of dealing with sb/sth; a way of doing or thinking about sth such as a problem or a task （待人接物或思考问题的）方式，方法，态度

ex.s: An Australian professor is developing a robot to monitor the health of grazing cattle, a development that could bring big changes to a profession that's relied largely on a low-tech approach for decades but is facing a labor shortage.
ex.t: 一位澳大利亚教授正在开发一种机器人，用于监测放牧牛群的健康，这一进展可能给一个几十年来主要依赖低技术手段、正面临劳动力短缺的行业带来巨大变化。

ex.s: Thus, it's of vital importance for job seekers to carefully strategize their approach to job application.
ex.t: 他们应该尽可能让自己对雇主具有吸引力。

ex.s: This approach spared me the discomfort of having to over-explain.
ex.t: 这种做法让我免去了不得不过度解释的尴尬。

ex.s: Farber is certain that the holistic approach will grow more popular with time, and if the past is any indication, he may be right: Since 1982, membership in the American Holistic Veterinary Medical Association has grown from 30 to over 700.
ex.t: 法伯确信整体疗法会随时间越来越受欢迎，如果过去可以作为参照的话，他可能是对的：自1982年以来，美国整体兽医学协会的会员已从30人增加到700多人。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
ex.t: SLEAP使用计算机视觉（计算机理解图像的能力）和深度学习（一种训练计算机像人脑一样学习和工作的AI方法），帮助研究者更快地处理图像。

ex.s: Interdisciplinary approach promotes creativity.
ex.t: 跨学科方法促进创新。

ex.s: illustrate a pointB. contrast approaches
ex.t: 阐明一个观点B. 对比不同方法

ex.s: A novel design approach to gardening has been gaining in popularity worldwide.
ex.t: 一种新颖的园艺设计方法正在全球范围内越来越受欢迎。

ex.s: Referred to as matrix planting, this approach aims for nature to do a lot more of the heavy lifting in the garden, and even some of the designing.
ex.t: 这种方法被称为“矩阵种植”，旨在让自然在花园中承担更多繁重工作，甚至部分设计。

ex.s: Illustrate an approach.
ex.t: 阐释一种方法。

ex.s: A systems approach to creating change is also built on the assumption that everyone in the system has equal power.
ex.t: 创造变革的系统方法还建立在一种假设之上，即系统中的每个人都有平等的权力。

ex.s: More researchers, policymakers and representatives from the food industry must learn to look beyond their direct lines of responsibility and adopt a systems approach.
ex.t: 更多研究者、政策制定者和食品行业代表必须学会超越其直接责任范围，并采用系统方法。

ex.s: But I recently came across a study that shows why his approach works
ex.t: 但我最近偶然看到一项研究，说明了他的方法为何有效

ex.s: highlight an experimentD. introduce an approach
ex.t: 强调一项实验D. 介绍一种方法

ex.s: In Bellevue, the switch to adaptive signals has been a lesson in the value of welcoming new approaches.
ex.t: “它不能解决所有问题，但对较小的城市来说，自适应信号灯有一些好处，”他说。

ex.s: A rethink is required — and as a new approach starts to become apparent, two ideas stand out.
ex.t: 需要重新思考——随着一种新的方法开始显现，有两个观点脱颖而出。

ex.s: “They need to be protectors of the land and contribute to the agricultural economy.” InSPIRE is investigating practical approaches to “low-impact” solar development, which focuses on establishing and operating solar farms in a way that is kinder to the land.
ex.t: “它们需要成为土地的保护者，并为农业经济做出贡献。”InSPIRE正在研究“低影响”太阳能开发的实用方案，重点关注以一种对土地更友好的方式建立和运营太阳能农场……

ex.s: Old Problem, New Approaches
ex.t: 老问题，新方法

ex.s: Such a playful approach could fuel their creativity for composition, if the student looks for ways to develop those wrong notes into something more attractive.
ex.t: 如果学生想方设法将这些错误的音符发展成更吸引人的东西，那么这种有趣的做法可以激发他们对构成的创造力。

ex.s: The result—an approach known as systems thinking—is now seen as essential in meeting global challenges.
ex.t: 结果——一种被称为系统思维的方法——现在被视为应对全球挑战的关键。

ex.s: Thirty years later， a woman approached me in a public place． "Excuse me， did you ever enter a residence， long ago， thinking it was the McNay Museum？"
ex.t: 三十年后，一位女士在公共场所走近我。“打扰一下，你很久以前是否曾进过一户住宅，以为那是麦克奈博物馆？”

ex.s: So to try to change a distinctly modern behavior, lawmakers and public health experts are reaching back to an old approach: They want to treat distracted driving like drunk driving.
ex.t: 所以，为了试图改变一种典型的现代行为，立法者和公共卫生专家正在回归一种旧方法：他们想把分心驾驶像酒驾一样对待。

defs.def: movement nearer to sb/sth in distance or time （在距离或时间上的）靠近，接近
the act of speaking to sb about sth, especially when making an offer or a request 接洽；建议；要求

ex.s: According to this theory, people approach digital texts with a mindset suited to social media, which are often not so serious, and devote less mental effort than when they are reading print.
ex.t: 根据这一理论，人们以一种适合社交媒体的心态对待电子文本——往往不那么严肃，投入的脑力也比读纸质文本时少。

ex.s: The whale hunters couldn’t believe their eyes when they saw the six men approaching.
ex.t: 捕鲸者看到那六个人走近时，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

defs.def: a path, road, etc. that leads to a place 通路；路径；道路

ex.s: It is also said that mice and snakes head for safer ground several days before an earthquake, while dogs avoiding the beach may be a sign that a tsunami is approaching.
ex.t: 还有人说，老鼠和蛇会在地震前几天逃往更安全的地方，而狗避开海滩可能是海啸即将来临的征兆。

defs.def: the part of an aircraft's flight immediately before landing 进场；进场着陆
a thing that is like sth else that is mentioned 相似（或近似）的事物

ex.s: People have been approaching him in the street; he’s had job    34    and all sorts,” Mr Anderson commented.
ex.t: 人们在大街上找他搭话；他有了工作____34____和各种各样的事，”安德森先生评论道。

chunks.cn: 一个 刚出现的 靠近
一个 体系 靠近
